definitions.explanation: the body's ability to resist and fight off infections and diseases

examples.japanese: {免疫力|めんえきりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧。
⟦{睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく}→睡眠不足：08690_suiminbusoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{免疫力|めんえきりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Lack of sleep weakens your immune system.

examples.japanese: {免疫力|めんえきりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I eat lots of vegetables to strengthen my immune system.

notes:
{免疫力|めんえきりょく} is the everyday and media word for the body's resistance to illness; doctors and textbooks usually speak of ⟦{免疫|めんえき}→免疫：05032_meneki⟧ itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {免疫力|めんえきりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧ / ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to boost one's immunity
- {免疫力|めんえきりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧ / ⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ / ⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: one's immunity drops
- {免疫力|めんえきりょく}⟦アップ→アップ：00005_appu⟧: "immunity boost" (advertising for foods and supplements)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{免疫|めんえき}→免疫：05032_meneki⟧: immunity — the biological system and the technical term; ⟦{免疫|めんえき}→免疫：05032_meneki⟧がある means "to be immune (to a disease)."
- ⟦{抵抗力|ていこうりょく}→抵抗力：21012_teikouryoku⟧: resistance — broader, the general strength to resist illness or fatigue; in everyday talk often interchangeable with {免疫力|めんえきりょく}.
